name: Project Graph
description: Whole-project graph spanning strategy, plans, modules, trackers, AI sessions, commits, and files in one navigable surface
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.tagline: Strategy, plans, trackers, sessions, and files in one navigable graph
marketplace.longDescription: Project Graph turns your workspace into a living, navigable map. See objectives connect to modules, features connect to bugs and sessions, and AI sessions connect to the files they edited. Switch between curated views like PM Big Picture, Architecture, Quality, and Delivery — each is a projection over one canonical graph of your project.
highlights: Typed nodes for strategy, plans, modules, features, bugs, AI sessions, commits, and files
Saved views: PM Big Picture, Architecture, Quality, Delivery, Customer Impact, Recent Execution
Per-type visibility, colors, and counts in the sidebar
Selected-node action ring with per-child-type drilldown and quick actions
Smooth pan/zoom with minimap and rollup legend

panels.title: Project Graph
panels.tooltip: Open the project graph: strategy, plans, modules, trackers, sessions, and files in one view.
